post.summary: Save AEMP 2.0 telematics data and link new equipment to a telematics provider
post.description: Posts ISO 15143-3 (AEMP 2.0) telematics data and, for machines that are not linked yet, creates the Procore equipment record and links it to your telematics provider account using OEMName and EquipmentID or SerialNumber. Use the v2.0 endpoint when the equipment is already linked.

requestBody.description: ISO 15143-3 (AEMP 2.0) fleet payload in JSON or XML format

snapshotTime.description: Timestamp represented by this fleet snapshot

OEMName.description: OEM or telematics provider name, used with EquipmentID or SerialNumber to match this machine to its Procore equipment record

EquipmentID.description: Provider equipment identifier. SerialNumber is used when EquipmentID is absent.

SerialNumber.description: Equipment serial number used as the provider identifier when EquipmentID is absent

snapshotTime.description: Timestamp represented by this fleet snapshot

OEMName.description: OEM or telematics provider name, used with EquipmentID or SerialNumber to match this machine to its Procore equipment record

EquipmentID.description: Provider equipment identifier. SerialNumber is used when EquipmentID is absent.

SerialNumber.description: Equipment serial number used as the provider identifier when EquipmentID is absent

201.description: Equipment records, telematics provider links, and AEMP telematics data saved

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"Fleet\":{\"snapshotTime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\",\"Equipment\":[{\"EquipmentHeader\":{\"UnitInstallDateTime\":\"2024-01-01T08:00:00Z\",\"OEMName\":\"Manufacturer\",\"Model\":\"Model-X\",\"EquipmentID\":\"EQ12345\",\"SerialNumber\":\"SN123456789012345\",\"PIN\":\"PIN1234567890123\"},\"AverageLoadFactorLast24\":{\"Percent\":75.25,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-15T12:00:00Z\"},\"Location\":{\"Latitude\":-33.867487,\"Longitude\":151.20699,\"Altitude\":45.5,\"AltitudeUnits\":\"metre\",\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"CumulativeActiveRegenerationHours\":{\"Hour\":120.5,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"CumulativeIdleHours\":{\"Hour\":200,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"CumulativeIdleNonOperatingHours\":{\"Hour\":50,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"CumulativeLoadCount\":{\"Count\":500,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"CumulativeOperatingHours\":{\"Hour\":1000.5,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"CumulativePowerTakeOffHours\":{\"Hour\":300,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"CumulativePayloadTotals\":{\"PayloadUnits\":\"kilogram\",\"Payload\":1500.5,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"DEFRemaining\":{\"Percent\":85.75,\"DEFTankCapacityUnits\":\"litre\",\"DEFTankCapacity\":50,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"Distance\":{\"OdometerUnits\":\"kilometre\",\"Odometer\":25000.5,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"EngineStatus\":{\"EngineNumber\":\"EN12345\",\"Running\":true,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"FuelUsed\":{\"FuelUnits\":\"litre\",\"FuelConsumed\":500,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"FuelUsedLast24\":{\"FuelUnits\":\"litre\",\"FuelConsumed\":50,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-15T12:00:00Z\"},\"FuelRemaining\":{\"Percent\":30.25,\"FuelTankCapacityUnits\":\"litre\",\"FuelTankCapacity\":100,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-16T12:00:00Z\"},\"MaximumSpeedLast24\":{\"SpeedUnits\":\"kilometres per hour\",\"Speed\":120.5,\"datetime\":\"2025-01-15T12:00:00Z\"}}]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.1/companies/1234/telematics/aemp", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
